title: SKE Crystal Strawberry Burst Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Strawberry Burst flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid delivers a vibrant and pure strawberry taste that captures the essence of freshly picked strawberries. This e-liquid is a dream come true for those who crave a straightforward, richly flavoured strawberry experience. As with all SKE Crystal Nic Salts, this e-liquid is designed to offer a smoother throat hit thanks to its nicotine salt formulation, which is perfect for ex-smokers or those new to vaping who are looking for an effective nicotine delivery without harshness. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures a great balance of flavour and vapour production, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung vaping setups. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit. Pair this e-liquid with your refillable pod system or starter vape kit for hassle-free, easy-to-use vaping.
